# `tokens`

<!-- Generated by `nadfun-export` from src/nadfun_export/tables.py. Do not edit. -->

One row per token launched on nad.fun (one CurveCreate event).

- Files: [`tokens.csv`](tokens.csv), [`tokens.json`](tokens.json)
- Schemas: [`schema.json`](schema.json) (Frictionless Table Schema), [`json-schema.json`](json-schema.json) (JSON Schema 2020-12 for the JSON file)
- Primary key: (`chain`, `token_address`)
- Row order: (`chain`, `block_number`, `log_index`), ascending. Chronological, so new rows are appended at the end.

Conventions (nulls, numbers, timestamps) are in [docs/conventions.md](../../docs/conventions.md).

| column | type | nullable | unit | description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `chain` | string (enum) | no |  | Chain the event was observed on. Values: `monad`. |
| `token_address` | address | no |  | Address of the launched ERC-20 token. |
| `launchpad` | string (enum) | no |  | Launchpad that emitted the event. Values: `nadfun`. |
| `version` | string (enum) | yes |  | nad.fun launch generation: `old` (contract_version `v3`) or `v2` (contract_version `nadfun-v2`). Values: `old`, `v2`. |
| `contract_version` | string | no |  | Label of the bonding-curve contract that emitted the event. |
| `contract_address` | address | no |  | Bonding-curve contract that emitted the event. |
| `creator` | address | no |  | Address that launched the token. |
| `name` | string | yes |  | Token name as recorded at launch. User-chosen, may contain any Unicode. |
| `symbol` | string | yes |  | Token symbol as recorded at launch. User-chosen. |
| `token_uri` | string | yes |  | URI of the token's off-chain metadata JSON. |
| `quote_token` | address | yes |  | Token the curve is priced in. Usually WMON (`0x3bd359c1119da7da1d913d1c4d2b7c461115433a`); some `v2` tokens pair with other tokens. |
| `pool_address` | address | yes |  | Pool address recorded for the token at launch. |
| `virtual_quote_reserve` | uint256 as decimal string | yes | base units of quote_token | Initial virtual reserve of the quote token on the curve. |
| `virtual_token_reserve` | uint256 as decimal string | yes | base units of the token | Initial virtual reserve of the launched token on the curve. |
| `target_token_amount` | uint256 as decimal string | yes | base units of the token | Target token amount of the curve. |
| `min_token_reserve` | uint256 as decimal string | yes | base units of the token | Minimum token reserve of the curve. Only set for `v2` tokens. |
| `created_at` | timestamp `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ` | yes | UTC | Timestamp of the block containing the launch event. |
| `block_number` | integer | no |  | Block containing the event. |
| `tx_hash` | tx hash | no |  | Transaction containing the event. |
| `log_index` | integer | no |  | Position of the event log within its block. |
